LCOM-STEEL.description: Load Combination Auto Generation - Steel (LCOM-STEEL). Runs the KDS 41 30 : 2022 steel auto load-combination generator; OPTION and DGNCODE drive the run while the optional nested blocks (RS_SCALE_FACTOR, WIND_LOAD_COMB, ORTHO_EFFECT, ADDITIONAL_LOAD, UNDERGROUND_LOAD) toggle and parameterize each generation feature. Absent optional blocks behave as unchecked / OPT_USE=false; the response returns the generated steel load combinations.

Argument.description: Auto-generation input parameters. Only OPTION and DGNCODE are required; every other block is optional and defaults to disabled when omitted.

OPTION.description: Add or Replace existing combinations (case-insensitive). ADD appends to existing combinations; REPLACE wipes this design type's combinations then regenerates.

DGNCODE.description: Design Code (case-insensitive). Only the steel code 'KDS 41 30 : 2022' is admitted.

RS_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Response Spectrum Scale Factor rows. Absent means no scale-up rows. Each row's LOAD_CASE must resolve to a spectrum load case; FACTOR must be in [0, 10].

WIND_LOAD_COMB.description: Wind Load Combination Set (optional; 3-state: absent / empty / populated). Absent or empty PARAMETERS leaves wind combinations untouched.

PARAMETERS.description: List of wind load combination sets.

BUILDING_TYPE.description: Wind Loads Group (case-insensitive). MIDDLE: ALONG required, TORSION not allowed, ACROSS optional. HIGH: ALONG required, ACROSS/TORSION optional and GUST_FACTOR/KAPPA_FACTOR required (high-rise dynamic wind).

WIND_LOAD_CASE.description: Wind Load Cases. Which keys are required depends on BUILDING_TYPE.

ACROSS.description: Across Wind Load Case (WA load case from the linked Static Wind Load when Across Wind is enabled).

TORSION.description: Torsional Wind Load Case (WT load case from the linked Static Wind Load when Torsional Wind is enabled).

GUST_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] GD gust factor; required only for high-rise dynamic wind, ignored for MIDDLE.

KAPPA_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] Kappa factor; required only for high-rise dynamic wind, ignored for MIDDLE.

ORTHO_EFFECT.description: Orthogonal Effect. When OPT_USE=false (or the block is omitted) any existing orthogonal-effect record is cleared. When OPT_USE=true, TYPE and LOAD_GROUP are required.

TYPE.description: [OPT_USE=true] Orthogonal Effect Type (case-insensitive). Required when OPT_USE=true.

LOAD_GROUP.description: [OPT_USE=true] Load Case1, Load Case2 (exactly 2 entries). Required when OPT_USE=true. The two entries must be the same load-case type (no ST/RS mixing) and distinct.

ADDITIONAL_LOAD.description: Additional Load. Each half (SPECIAL_LOAD / VERTICAL_LOAD) is optional; an omitted half behaves as OPT_USE=false. When neither half is enabled any prior additional-load record is cleared.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Special Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR, SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Load Factor. Required and must be > 0 when OPT_USE=true.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors. Required when OPT_USE=true; each FACTOR must be > 0 and LOAD_CASE must resolve.

VERTICAL_LOAD.description: Vertical Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, FORCE_FACTOR is required.

FORCE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Force Factor. Required and must be > 0 when OPT_USE=true.

UNDERGROUND_LOAD.description: Underground Load. Absent is treated as OPT_USE=false (clears underground state). When OPT_USE=true, SCALE_FACTOR and LOAD_CASE_LIST are required.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground scale factors. Required when OPT_USE=true; each FACTOR must be in [0, 10] and LOAD_CASE must resolve.

LOAD_CASE_LIST.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground load case list. Required when OPT_USE=true and must contain at least one entry. (LoadCase, DIRECTION) must be unique across rows.

LOAD_CASE.description: Seismic Load Case List - LoadCase name.

LOAD_CASE_SEISMIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Seismic. Each name must resolve to an STLD of LoadCaseType EEP.

LOAD_CASE_STATIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Static. Each name must resolve to an STLD of LoadCaseType EH.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Underground special load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR, SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to use special load for underground load.

VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Load Factor. Required and must be > 0 when OPT_USE=true.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors for underground special load. Required when OPT_USE=true; each FACTOR must be > 0 and (LoadCase, Type) must be unique.
